modern: If a thing is difficult for you to accomplish, do not think that it is impossible for man; but if anything is possible for man and in keeping with his nature, think that you can attain it too.
original: If a thing is difficult to be accomplished by thyself, do not think that it is impossible for man: but if anything is possible for man and conformable to his nature, think that this can be attained by thyself too.
notification: If a thing is difficult for you to accomplish, do not think that it is impossible for man…
notification_original: If a thing is difficult to be accomplished by thyself, do not think that it is impossible for man…

explained.summary: If something is hard for you, don’t assume it’s impossible for anyone. And if something is possible for human beings and suits our nature, assume you can do it too. Other people’s achievements are evidence of what you are capable of.
explained.today: If a colleague learnt a new language at forty, or a neighbour gave up smoking, or a friend ran their first 10k after years off, that’s proof the thing can be done by an ordinary person. The difficulty you feel isn’t the same as impossibility.
